notes.title: Mosaique Neko Waifus 5 and Doge Trader
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39593912/8c1d2096fc3351dd2d2cafc65da2964208b1855a.jpg

Hello dear friends. It's been a while since you heard from us but we are coming back. The new "Neko Waifus" game will be released this year - yay for that. But there is also a surprise project we have for you, that we are currently working on.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2165610/Mosaique_Neko_Waifus_5/

You can expect the new "Waifus" announcement around early October. Get ready to experience many exciting puzzles and catch up with 5 new girls, because the number of the game is "5" - it is only reasonable.

And let the rest be a sweet secret for now ;)

You can follow "Lil Hentai Games" on Twitter

https://twitter.com/lilHentaiGames

You may also find this new thing we have been working on interesting.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2068880/Doge_Trader/

It looks quite different from "Mosaique Neko Waifus" games? Well yes but actually no. It is a game about trading cryptocurrency and dog memes, it's called "Doge Trader". Similar themes include:

• Abilities system you will feel quite at home with while playing "Doge Trader". Creating your custom build is also going to be quite familiar.
• The Dialogues/Visual Novel aspect is quite a bit bigger than that in "Neko Waifus", and "meaningful choices" are the name of the game. 
• You can bank on Achievements, Cards, and Steam Point Shop Items being a big part of the experience
• The game will be localized into 13 languages, including yours?
• Humor!

And also there is some stuff unique to "Doge Trader" that "Neko Waifus" games don't have:

• "Doge Trader" is a Rougelite - it plays differently every time you try it
• Trading crypto - easy at first, kind of like a one-button clicker, but becomes more challenging as you progress in the game. Watch out to not get too addicted.
• Have you heard about "NFT-s"? The game dives into that slippery topic quite a bit and allows you to become a true Tycoon of JPG images. Is it scammy to charge money for internet images everyone can download? Of course not! 
• Doge Meme value!
• There will be no adult content of any kind here (SORRY). 

(Disclaimer: "Doge Trader" is not connected to any real blockchain tho - this is important to note as you are not at any real risk of losing real assets, just pure good fun)

If you think "Doge Trader" is something you might like, please wishlist it on Steam. Wishlists help us a bunch and we really appreciate them. "Doge Trader" will be released in 2023. 

Follow "Doge Trader" on Twitter!

https://twitter.com/DogeTraderGame

Thank you for your attention and your love for our games!

Cheers!

notes.title: "Mosaique Neko Waifus 3" just released!
notes.content:
Ahh "Mosaique Neko Waifus". The forbidden pleasure...
Well not any longer!

The new one is out NOW! So grab a copy if this is your thing ;)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1385730/Mosaique_Neko_Waifus_3/
What's new?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/130cb1dcb42cd74cc8b660d74fdb5a3b7e5cb2b7.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/e9f505e8dc44510f06e9d81f6e097911d522ef28.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/bad349e0499b01c71eb811f50e6f59a39ca754ad.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34060471/353798730706e2b2013309f6ee72891717ed4ade.jpg

• 2 new girls: Coco and Luli.
• 2 new old girls: Sayouri and Niko
• 14 classic abilities that have not been changed much
• 4 new abilities: Love Axe, Laser Burst, Mirroring Edge, and Lazy Bomb. You will love the Lazy Bomb if you are a strategic player
• Ability stash! There is only a limited amount of ability slots so you need to manage which ones you want to be equipped
• If you want new ability slots you need to farm "Bubble Wraps" from talking to girls
• 16 SFW Puzzles
• 90 Items
• 100 Achievements

( I cannot say whether there is a FREE R18 Expansion or not! But you never know, life might surprise you )
